name: claude-workflow
description: Enforces structured, human-in-the-loop software development. Every feature goes through Idea → Spec → Plan → Implement with mandatory human approval gates before any code is written.
author: Michael-laspina

commands.name: claude-workflow:setup
commands.description: Initialize project constitution and workflow directories

commands.name: claude-workflow:review
commands.description: Generate structured spec via 3-agent review (requirements-analyst, devils-advocate, technical-analyst)

commands.name: claude-workflow:implement
commands.description: TDD implementation loop (red/green/refactor) for an approved feature spec

commands.name: claude-workflow:audit
commands.description: Quality audit of artifacts and implementation for a feature
